import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/training_6.csv"
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and types:
    # Target schema: ['nombre': string, 'n_concursados': int, 'n_aprobados': int, 'año': int]
    # Convert columns to correct types explicitly
    df = df[['nombre', 'n_concursados', 'n_aprobados', 'año']].copy()
    df['nombre'] = df['nombre'].astype(str)
    df['n_concursados'] = df['n_concursados'].astype(int)
    df['n_aprobados'] = df['n_aprobados'].astype(int)
    df['año'] = df['año'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_84/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
